what: It franchises fast casual submarine sandwich shops, with 3,300 stores in two countries, nearly all run by franchise owners.
risks: The company works in a very competitive industry, which could hurt its business and results.
Food safety problems, food-borne illness and public health worries could harm the business.
The store returns and earnings figures it reports may not predict how well a new franchise store will do.
Unexpected events have hurt the business before and could hurt it again.
If the company or its franchise owners' outside providers cannot carry out a recovery plan after a disaster, the business could suffer badly.
